overview: Harasta Market Days is a bilingual Arabic-first rental marketplace app for a Syrian commercial market. Merchants can browse pricing for small and large retail spaces, submit booking requests with auto-calculated totals, and admins can manage all bookings through a secure dashboard.
features: Arabic-first RTL layout with English toggle
Dual pricing tables for small (31) and large (11) stores
Booking form with auto-calculated rental + deposit total
Admin dashboard with booking management (Internet Identity login)
